question.text: Green bonds are debt instruments specifically issued to raise funds for:

answer.text: Sustainable projects such as renewable energy, clean transportation, climate change adaptation, efficient and green buildings, and biodiversity conservation
Agricultural activities exclusively for organic farming
Purchase of government securities during the Union Budget presentation

explanation.text: The Logic: Green debt securities are debt instruments issued to raise funds for sustainable projects and assets such as renewable energy, clean transportation, climate change adaptation, efficient and green buildings, and biodiversity conservation. India has also issued Sovereign Green Bonds in this category. The Trap: "Green" refers to environmental sustainability, not the colour of currency notes (option C), agriculture in general (option B), or budget operations (option D). Note: Anchor green bonds to the five source-listed use cases: renewable energy, clean transportation, climate change adaptation, efficient/green buildings, and biodiversity conservation.
